qt-sm.walkthrough.signIn.title: Sign in to Qt Account

Sign in to your Qt Account to get started. This is what lets you download and install Qt.

[Sign In](command:qt-sm.login)
qt-sm.walkthrough.installExtensions.desc:
Add the Qt C++ Extension Pack — it brings all the tools you need to work with Qt right into VS Code.

[Install Qt C++ Extension Pack](command:qt-sm.installRequiredExtensions)
qt-sm.walkthrough.installQtFramework.des:
This is the heart of Qt — you need it to build and run any app. Get the latest version, or pick a specific one if your project needs it.

[Get latest Qt Framework](command:qt-sm.installPackage?%7B%22version%22%3A%22latest%22%2C%22product%22%3A%22qtframework%22%7D)

[Select version...](command:qt-sm.installPackage)
